driverSettings.title: [as] Driver Settings
driverSettings.subtitle: [as] Control your duty status, custom map navigation units, and road alerts.
driverSettings.activeDutyDesc: [as] Toggle on to appear online and accept backhaul cargo matches.
driverSettings.audioAlertsDesc: [as] Play a loud ringtone whenever a high-match route is offered.
driverSettings.autoNavigateDesc: [as] Instantly pull up maps right after accepting a cargo load.
driverSettings.gpsSyncDesc: [as] Allow dispatchers and buyers to track your truck location during a job.
driverSettings.nightModeDesc: [as] Switch to a dark-charcoal UI to prevent eye fatigue while driving at night.

shipperSettings.title: [as] Shipper Settings
shipperSettings.subtitle: [as] Control your system preferences, API integrations, and display adjustments.
shipperSettings.milestoneAlertsDesc: [as] Send real-time alerts whenever custom checks, pickups, or deliveries happen.
shipperSettings.erpSyncDesc: [as] Restrict third-party software from fetching invoice and tracking data logs.
shipperSettings.darkModeDesc: [as] Switch between standard light screen and cozy dark-room dashboard mode.

adminSettings.title: [as] Admin Settings
adminSettings.subtitle: [as] Control platform-wide configuration, moderation rules, and access policies.
adminSettings.newRegistrationsDesc: [as] Allow new buyers, shippers, drivers, and agencies to sign up.
adminSettings.autoVerifyDriversDesc: [as] Skip manual document review for drivers who were previously approved.
adminSettings.maintenanceModeDesc: [as] Show a maintenance banner and pause new shipment/order matching platform-wide.
adminSettings.autoEscalateDesc: [as] Flag complaints left open for more than 48 hours for priority review.
adminSettings.requireDocReviewDesc: [as] Block a vehicle from accepting shipments until its documents are admin-verified.
